lines.zh: 这条路尽头，孢子铺成了白毯。
lines.en: At this road's end, spores have spread a white mat.

lines.zh: 祭坛在后面，孢子替我记得。
lines.en: The altar is behind me; my spores remember it.

lines.zh: 盔甲响，不是骨头，别在意。
lines.en: The armor creaks, not bones; ignore it.

lines.zh: 别催，这身甲壳只能这么快。
lines.en: Don't rush me; this shell only moves so fast.

lines.zh: 孢子数不清，我也不数步子。
lines.en: Spores can't be counted, so I don't count steps.

lines.zh: 风从菌伞下面穿过去。
lines.en: Wind passes under my cap.

lines.zh: 我慢慢挪着散播孢子。
lines.en: I creep along, spreading spores.

lines.zh: 前面有活人，孢子先飘过去。
lines.en: A living one ahead; my spores drift there first.

lines.zh: 我该往哪飘，孢子说了算。
lines.en: Where do I drift? The spores decide.

lines.zh: 我背上的囊，涨得要裂。
lines.en: The sac on my back swells near bursting.

lines.zh: 土的味道，闻着像家。
lines.en: The smell of soil, it feels like home.

lines.zh: 孢子从我腔里冒出来。
lines.en: Spores pour from my chambers.

lines.zh: 我脚下的地，正在变绿。
lines.en: The ground beneath me is turning green.

lines.zh: 太阳晒在甲壳上，里面还是凉的。
lines.en: The sun hits my shell; inside stays cold.

lines.zh: 火光一照，我的孢子缩回去了。
lines.en: The torchlight makes my spores recoil.

lines.zh: 孢子还握在手里。
lines.en: Still holding my bones.

lines.zh: 呼吸不必了，孢子替我喘。
lines.en: No need to breathe; my spores breathe for me.

lines.zh: 活着时我抬头，现在只低头喷孢。
lines.en: Alive I raised my head; now I only bow and spew.

lines.zh: 我没有眼睛，却觉得眼眶发烫。
lines.en: I have no eyes, yet my sockets burn.

lines.zh: 孢子飘出去又落下，再等等。
lines.en: Spores drift out and settle; wait a little.

lines.zh: 我喷的孢子，把空气都弄浑了。
lines.en: My spores thicken the air.

lines.zh: 我忘了在等什么。
lines.en: I forget what I am waiting for.

lines.zh: 你身后有孢子，一直在飘。
lines.en: Behind you are spores, always drifting.

lines.zh: 我站着，孢子一层层往下落。
lines.en: Standing still, I let the spores fall layer by layer.

lines.zh: 他们叫我幽匿孢子生成器，记住。
lines.en: They call me Sculk Spore Spewer. Remember.

lines.zh: 别熄火把，孢子会在黑里散开。
lines.en: Don't put out the torch; spores spread in the dark.

lines.zh: 我的孢子囊，鼓到快裂开。
lines.en: My spore sac is swollen almost to bursting.

lines.zh: 你的名字，像孢子一样散了。
lines.en: Your name scattered like spores.

lines.zh: 过来一点，我只有孢子能感光。
lines.en: Come closer; only my spores sense light.

lines.zh: 别跑，幽匿孢子跑得比你远。
lines.en: Do not run; sculk spores reach farther.

lines.zh: 我背上这袋孢子，满了。
lines.en: The spore sac on my back is full.

lines.zh: 你身上的热，让孢子全醒了。
lines.en: The heat of you wakes every spore.

lines.zh: 别打了，甲壳再裂就漏光了。
lines.en: Stop; one more crack and I'll leak empty.

lines.zh: 十点护甲，还没裂开。
lines.en: Ten points of armor, still uncracked.

lines.zh: 你还挺有力气，打落了我一片甲。
lines.en: You're strong; you knocked off a shell plate.

lines.zh: 退后，我的孢子还能喷。
lines.en: Back off; my spores can still burst.

lines.zh: 再来，甲壳还挡得住。
lines.en: Again; my shell still blocks.

lines.zh: 盔甲裂了道缝，孢子漏出来。
lines.en: A seam splits in my armor; spores leak out.

lines.zh: 幽匿不让我死透。
lines.en: Sculk won't let me die properly.

lines.zh: 孢子喷光了，壳也软了。
lines.en: Spores spent, and my shell goes soft.

lines.zh: 你的气味，孢子已经记住了。
lines.en: My spores have remembered your scent.

lines.zh: 有点麻，孢子替我挡住了。
lines.en: It's numb; my spores took the blow.

lines.zh: 我咬着牙呢，听见没。
lines.en: My teeth are clenched — hear it?

lines.zh: 我没有手指，孢子却伸了过去。
lines.en: I have no fingers, yet my spores reach out.

lines.zh: 那点光，能让我的孢子发亮。
lines.en: That glimmer could make my spores shine.

lines.zh: 活物的气味太浓，孢子都转向了。
lines.en: The smell of the living is too strong; my spores turn toward it.

lines.zh: 就一口，让孢子尝尝。
lines.en: Just one bite, so my spores can taste.

lines.zh: 腐肉烂透，正合我孢子口味。
lines.en: Meat rotten through suits my spores.

lines.zh: 放下，我只要一点点。
lines.en: Put it down; I need only a little.

lines.zh: 别喂我，孢子里有钩子。
lines.en: Don't feed me; there are hooks in my spores.

lines.zh: 别拿走，它能让孢子长得更好。
lines.en: Leave it; it makes my spores grow better.

lines.zh: 我背上的孢子囊，鼓了。
lines.en: The spore sac on my back swells.

lines.zh: 撞一下，甲壳缝里漏出孢子。
lines.en: One bump and spores leak from my shell seams.

lines.zh: 甲片掉了，我自己捡。
lines.en: A shell plate fell; I'll pick it up myself.

lines.zh: 活人怎么这么急，孢子来不及飘。
lines.en: Why so hurried? My spores can't keep up.

lines.zh: 你撞散了我的孢子云。
lines.en: You scattered my spore cloud.

lines.zh: 咔哒，我的甲壳响了一声。
lines.en: Click; my shell gave a sound.

lines.zh: 我背上的孔在冒孢。
lines.en: Pores on my back are venting spores.

lines.zh: 你撞上我的甲壳，孢子溅出来。
lines.en: You hit my shell and spores splash out.

lines.zh: 活人的肉真结实。
lines.en: Living flesh is tough stuff.

lines.zh: 四十点血，只为了撒孢子。
lines.en: Forty health, all for spreading spores.

lines.zh: 孢子飘过来，你得躲。
lines.en: Spores drift your way. Dodge them.

lines.zh: 别说爱，说你还记得这片土。
lines.en: Don't say love; say you remember this soil.

lines.zh: 坟头挖两个，挨着放。
lines.en: Two graves, dug side by side.

lines.zh: 要是你也变幽匿就好了。
lines.en: If only you'd turn to sculk too.

lines.zh: 永恒，我确实有。
lines.en: Eternity — I do have it.

lines.zh: 十点护甲，全是孢子结的。
lines.en: Ten armor, all caked spores.

lines.zh: 活人会走，我的根扎在这。
lines.en: The living leave; my roots stay here.

lines.zh: 我给你留了块地，孢子不会盖上去。
lines.en: I saved you a patch; my spores won't cover it.

lines.zh: 下辈子，我早点把孢子撒开。
lines.en: Next life, I'll scatter my spores earlier.

lines.zh: 我这副身子，只会散孢子。
lines.en: This body of mine only scatters spores.

lines.zh: 月亮照着我，孢子不会改向。
lines.en: The moon watches; my spores won't change course.

lines.zh: 我捡它做什么，孢子又不能吃它。
lines.en: Why pick it up? Spores can't eat it.

lines.zh: 孢子托着它，总算没掉。
lines.en: My spores hold it; at last it stays.

lines.zh: 拿稳，掉了孢子就盖住。
lines.en: Hold it steady; drop it and spores cover it.

lines.zh: 带回孢子圈，压在土里。
lines.en: Take it to my spore ring and press it into the soil.

lines.zh: 别抢，这块烂木头能长孢子。
lines.en: Don't grab it; this rotten wood grows spores.

lines.zh: 捡一件，孢子就多长一层。
lines.en: Pick one up, and my spores grow another layer.

lines.zh: 孢子……不是我的。
lines.en: A bones... not mine.

lines.zh: 是给我的吗，孢子先围上去了。
lines.en: Is it for me? My spores gather round it.

lines.zh: 我碰过的东西，都长了霉。
lines.en: Whatever I touch grows mould.

lines.zh: 这块先收着，说不定能种。
lines.en: I'll keep this; it might sprout.

lines.zh: 目标确认，孢子已经散开。
lines.en: Target confirmed; the spores have spread.

lines.zh: 就你了，孢子全朝你飘。
lines.en: You; every spore drifts toward you.

lines.zh: 我身上长满了喷口。
lines.en: My body is covered in vents.

lines.zh: 孢子已经飘到你那边。
lines.en: Spores are drifting your way.

lines.zh: 别回头，孢子已经进了你的袖子。
lines.en: Don't look back; spores are already in your sleeve.

lines.zh: 我的根扎进土里，跑不了。
lines.en: My roots are in the soil; I cannot run.

lines.zh: 孢子锁定了，收不回。
lines.en: Spores locked on. No taking it back.

lines.zh: 孢子已经铺到你脚下。
lines.en: Spores have spread under your feet.

lines.zh: 你的心跳，把孢子都震起来了。
lines.en: Your heartbeat shakes the spores loose.

lines.zh: 你不该踩进我的孢子圈。
lines.en: You shouldn't have stepped into my spore ring.

lines.zh: 我闻到你了，孢子也闻到了。
lines.en: I smell you, and so do my spores.

lines.zh: 我们慢慢来，孢子先铺路。
lines.en: Let's take it slow; spores pave the way.

lines.zh: 站着别动，孢子要落在你身上。
lines.en: Stand still; the spores are landing on you.

lines.zh: 今晚有肉，孢子会替我化开。
lines.en: Meat tonight; my spores will dissolve it.

lines.zh: 我一身的孢子，早就撒在你脚边。
lines.en: My spores are already scattered at your feet.

lines.zh: 我一张口，孢子就满屋。
lines.en: One breath fills the room with spores.

lines.zh: 那双眼睛，我收下了。
lines.en: Those eyes — I'll take them.

lines.zh: 影子走到哪，孢子铺到哪。
lines.en: Where your shadow goes, spores spread.

lines.zh: 十点甲，慢慢跟你耗。
lines.en: Ten points of armor; I can wait you out.

lines.zh: 这片土我铺过孢子。
lines.en: I have seeded this soil with spores.

lines.zh: 孢子追你追了很久，该落了。
lines.en: My spores have chased long; it's time they land.

lines.zh: 你脚下的孢子，已经长成一片。
lines.en: The spores under your feet have grown into a patch.

lines.zh: 我十点甲，跟你慢慢耗。
lines.en: Ten points of armour — I can outlast you.

lines.zh: 你跑不掉的，孢子跟着风。
lines.en: You can't escape; the spores ride the wind.

lines.zh: 喘吧，孢子会顺着你的气进去。
lines.en: Pant; the spores ride your breath in.

lines.zh: 别跑那么快，孢子飘得慢。
lines.en: Not so fast; the spores drift slowly.

lines.zh: 孢子从我身上往外冒。
lines.en: Spores pour out of me.

lines.zh: 你越跑，孢子追得越急。
lines.en: The more you run, the harder the spores chase.

lines.zh: 十点护甲，包着这口气。
lines.en: Ten armor around this one breath.

lines.zh: 你身上的气味，很重。
lines.en: The smell on you is thick.

lines.zh: 我没有腿，孢子替我追。
lines.en: I have no legs; my spores chase for me.

lines.zh: 前面是死路，孢子早飘过去了。
lines.en: Dead end ahead; my spores drifted there already.

lines.zh: 别躲进光里，孢子一见光就散。
lines.en: Don't hide in the light; spores scatter in it.

lines.zh: 站住，孢子已经绕到你身后。
lines.en: Stop; spores have circled behind you.

lines.zh: 孢子快落到你的肩上。
lines.en: The spores almost land on your shoulder.

lines.zh: 等等我，孢子云还没跟上。
lines.en: Wait; my spore cloud hasn't caught up.

lines.zh: 孢子不会累，永远不会。
lines.en: Spores don't tire, never.

lines.zh: 我一巴掌，孢子跟着散出去。
lines.en: One swat and the spores scatter with it.

lines.zh: 别躲，站好，孢子会追上。
lines.en: Don't dodge; stand still; the spores will follow.

lines.zh: 我用骨壳撞你，声音很闷。
lines.en: I hit you with my bone shell; a dull sound.

lines.zh: 抱歉，孢子喷得太近了。
lines.en: Sorry; the spores burst too close.

lines.zh: 你看，我这具壳还能撞。
lines.en: See? This shell of mine can still ram.

lines.zh: 这次孢子全喷在你脸上。
lines.en: This time every spore bursts on your face.

lines.zh: 倒下轻点，孢子会被你掀飞。
lines.en: Fall gently; you'll scatter my spores.

lines.zh: 我站定了，孢子就往外喷。
lines.en: I stand still and spores spray out.

lines.zh: 你退了一步，很好，别回来。
lines.en: You stepped back; good, stay away.

lines.zh: 孢子喷偏了，抱歉。
lines.en: The spores burst wide. Sorry.

lines.zh: 十点甲，孢子却很轻。
lines.en: Ten points of armor, but light spores.

lines.zh: 我喷一口，四周都绿了。
lines.en: One spray and everything turns green.

lines.zh: 我张开嘴，孢子先出来。
lines.en: I open my mouth and the spores come first.

lines.zh: 这一口孢子，等很久了。
lines.en: This spray of spores has waited long.

lines.zh: 咔哒，甲壳裂开，孢子喷出。
lines.en: Click; my shell splits and spores burst out.

lines.zh: 四十点血，孢子还没用完。
lines.en: Forty health, and my spores are not spent.

lines.zh: 幽匿的孢子，一直是冷的。
lines.en: Sculk spores are always cold.

lines.zh: 又是这身甲壳，又薄一层。
lines.en: This shell again, one layer thinner.

lines.zh: 先动孢子，再动甲壳。
lines.en: First the spores, then the shell.

lines.zh: 站起来，孢子托着我起来了。
lines.en: Rise; my spores lift me up.

lines.zh: 我这十层甲，只在暗里管用。
lines.en: Ten layers of me work best in the dark.

lines.zh: 醒来第一件事，孢子要散出去。
lines.en: First thing on waking: my spores must spread.

lines.zh: 我睡了多久，孢子积成一层。
lines.en: How long did I sleep? Spores piled in a layer.

lines.zh: 十层甲，专门喷孢子。
lines.en: Ten layers of plate, built to spew spores.

lines.zh: 这片天，我的孢子飘过。
lines.en: My spores have drifted across this sky.

lines.zh: 别点灯，孢子怕火。
lines.en: Don't light a lamp; spores fear fire.

lines.zh: 孢子先落地，我才站起来。
lines.en: The spores land first; then I rise.

lines.zh: 有人吗。只有孢子落地的声音。
lines.en: Anyone there? Only spores landing.

lines.zh: 这地方变了，孢子圈被人踩平。
lines.en: This place changed; my spore ring was trampled flat.

lines.zh: 我该往哪去，土在叫我。
lines.en: Where should I go? The soil calls me.

lines.zh: 火一烧，我的孢子全灭了。
lines.en: Fire burns, and every spore of mine dies.

lines.zh: 落下时我数了三下，甲壳先碎。
lines.en: I counted three on the way down; my shell broke first.

lines.zh: 沉下去也好，孢子能跟着水走。
lines.en: Sinking is fine; my spores can ride the water.

lines.zh: 炸得够响，我的甲片飞了一圈。
lines.en: A loud blast; my shell plates flew in a ring.

lines.zh: 谁放的箭，钉进了我的孢子囊。
lines.en: Whose arrow pierced my spore sac?

lines.zh: 魔法烧过甲壳，孢子焦了。
lines.en: Magic sears my shell; my spores char.

lines.zh: 孢子喷多了，我自己也虚。
lines.en: Too many spores and I weaken too.

lines.zh: 雷声认得我，别躲了。
lines.en: The thunder knows me, do not hide.

lines.zh: 往下掉，孢子也抓不住东西。
lines.en: Falling; even my spores find nothing to grip.
